identificationModule.briefTitle: A Dose Finding Study of KRN321(Darbepoetin Alfa) for the Treatment of Anemia in Subjects With Solid Tumor
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Randomized, Dose - Finding Study of KRN321(Darbepoetin Alfa) for the Treatment of Anemia in Subjects With Solid Tumor

descriptionModule.briefSummary: To assess the clinical effective dose of KRN321 administered with once triweekly schedule.

primaryOutcomes.measure: To compare the effectiveness of KRN321(darbepoetin alfa) on the proportion of subjects achieving hemoglobin response

secondaryOutcomes.measure: To compare the proportion of subjects who receive red blood cell transfusions or show the hemoglobin level below 8 g/dL
To compare the proportion of subjects who receive red blood cell transfusions
To compare the effectiveness of KRN321 based on quality of life scores

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* patients diagnosed as solid tumor or malignant lymphoma
* patients receiving cyclic chemotherapy
* written informed consent
* hemoglobin concentration below 11 d/dL at enrollment
* life expectancy of more than 4 months

Exclusion Criteria:

* hemolysis, gastrointestinal bleeding, postoperative bleeding
* iron deficiency
* megaloblastic anemia
* received \> 2 RBC transfusions within 4 weeks before randomization or any RBC transfusion within 2 weeks before randomization
* any primary hematological disorder that could cause anemia
* prior treatment with KRN321
* received erythropoetin therapy within 8 weeks before treatment
